question: Which great māyā goddess of ka-form grants constant protection in the west?
premises: Protection is sought in the west
She is described as having the form of ka and protects always
inference: Mahāmāyā in the form of ka always protects in the western direction.
uncertainties: kasvarūpā may refer to a specific bīja or form
plain_english: May Mahāmāyā, whose form is ka, always protect in the west.
